description: Independent boutiques and clothing stores in a city, from within's directory of about 8,700 shops in more than 140 cities. Each shop comes with the kind of shop it is, its street and neighbourhood, a few designers it stocks, its page on shopwithin.co, and whether it sells on within. Use this when someone asks for clothing stores or boutiques in a city or neighbourhood, for luxury boutiques, for vintage, consignment or sneaker stores, for the stores that stock a designer (stockists) in a city or country, or for a shop by a word in its name. The list is A to Z, not ranked, with no ratings or reviews. Most shops in it do not sell on within. With no city it lists the cities covered.

city.description: The city the shops are in, e.g. 'Toronto', 'New York', 'Melbourne': a place to shop, not the shopper's own location. A part of a city works too: 'Brooklyn'.

country.description: A country name or two letter code, e.g. 'Australia', to search every city in it or to list its cities.

designer.description: A designer or brand the shop stocks, e.g. 'Diesel', 'Goyard', 'Zoe Kratzmann'.

kind.description: The kind of shop, one of: vintage, consignment, archive, sneakers, streetwear, jewellery, watches, menswear, womenswear, concept.

name.description: A word in the shop's name, e.g. 'archive', 'kith'.

neighbourhood.description: A neighbourhood in the city, e.g. 'Yorkville', 'SoHo', 'Le Marais'.

offset.description: Shops to skip; use next_offset from the page before.

name: boutique_directory
title: Find boutiques in a city
